rubric.trap: +1 if a wrong option is the result of a named common mistake
rubric.rare: +1 if a hard or rarely seen word is the point
rubric.levels: up to 2 Easy, 3 Medium, 4 or more Hard

likelihood: High if the topic appeared in at least 2/3 of the analysed papers, Medium if at least 1/3, Low otherwise. Always read it with the number of papers.
